info.title: store402 — agent boutique (x402, USDC)
info.summary: store402 is an online store whose customers are AI agents: every paid endpoint is protected by the x402 payment protocol and paid in USDC (scheme "exact"), on the active rails only.
info.description: Online store for AI agents, paid over the x402 protocol in USDC (scheme "exact"). Environment: mainnet (rails eip155:8453 + solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp — mainnet (REAL USDC)). Free tier: 3 calls/client IP/UTC day on the commodity services, mode "opt-in" — in "opt-in" (default) a free call requires the X-Store402-Free-Tier: 1 request header (otherwise a normal 402, no quota consumed). Generated from the catalog — prices come from the single source of truth (servicePrices.ts). Private endpoints /dashboard and /logs are intentionally NOT listed here.
